query:
SELECT LEFT(body, 500)
                FROM logs
                WHERE ts > $1 AND ts <= $2
                  AND ($3 = '' OR service_name = $3)
                  AND severity >= $4
                  AND ($5 = '' OR body ~* $5)
                  AND ($6 = '' OR attributes->>$6 = $7)
                ORDER BY ts DESC
                LIMIT 1
